name: s3-fused-hit-is-post-authorized
description: S3 Outcome 2 (SRCH-002): every fragment that survives fusion is re-resolved against live PostgreSQL state before it can be returned, so a candidate the external index still holds cannot enter an answer on the strength of what the index believed when it was written. The final app.evidence_fragment_readable definition in migration 000077 requires the object, version, retention, extraction and scope membership to remain live. Removing that live-state block (the weakening) makes retained artifacts behind a stale index candidate readable. TestS3HybridWorkspaceSearchNegativeControls removes an indexed file through the production synchronization path while keeping the workspace active, proves the external index selected and retained its fragment, and requires vector and hybrid search to reject that exact fragment. It separately retains the whole-grant revocation control.

          AND o.current_version_id = v.id

          AND vr.state = 'ACTIVE' AND vr.queryable

          AND ae.extraction_id = f.extraction_id

mutations.new:
AND wrs.access_mode = 'WORKSPACE_MANAGED'
          AND os.membership_state = 'ACTIVE'
          AND ae.extraction_id = f.extraction_id
          AND er.state = 'ACTIVE' AND er.queryable
          AND vr.state = 'ACTIVE' AND vr.queryable
          AND v.state = 'CURRENT'
          AND o.current_version_id = v.id
          AND o.lifecycle_state = 'ACTIVE'

baseline_meaning: On the unmutated tree an object removed through synchronization is absent from vector and hybrid results while its fragment remains in the external index and the workspace remains active; revoking the whole grant also empties every mode.
mutant_meaning: Without the final SQL gate's live object/version/retention/extraction/membership block, retained artifacts for the removed fragment enter the active workspace result from the still-populated index, so the stale-index control fails: exactly the declared RED negative control (an index must never authorize a hit), and the mutant is killed by the registered probe rather than by an unrelated migration or compile failure.
runner: tests/contracts/mutation-runner/main.go executes this case from tests/contracts/mutation-registry.json under the POSTGRES_INTEGRATION harness for the invariant entry `acceptance.search.stale-index-postauthorization`; the identical case is committed both here and in the registry so the proof is pinned to the product guard.
